generated.prop: small arrangement of smooth river stones
generated.details: In the middle plane at left, three smooth river stones rest separately on their flattened undersides directly on the tabletop beside the laptop, clear of its silhouette and access gap.
Its padded arms and back join an upholstered base supporting deep seat cushions; face it toward the laptop with legroom.
A cream woven rug lies beneath the table and sofa, its interlaced fibers and bound edge visible on the near-plane center-left floor.
A small cream ceramic relief mounted on the far upper-left wall has shallow raised curves integral to its solid clay backing.
